timing.lookup: actual per-buffer host_pts_ns plus in-buffer sample position

clock.alignment: Full-reference waveform anchors independent of tested clock; local waveform matching uses only those anchors.
clock.heldout_grid: 0.73+n seconds; nearest telemetry row evaluated at delay-query midpoint, no temporal clock interpolation
clock.qualification: >=200ms from audio transitions, playback_started, play/resume, not failed/drained, both waveform correlations>=.99 and stereo source positions agree within1sample

limits: Overall audio acceptance fails if any uncommanded quiet gaps exist, independent of steady clock gate.
Process-tap acquisition timing is not physical speaker audibility; GetDelay includes downstream/device latency. No fitted constant removes a domain offset.
RMS edges use5ms bins; small source-edge residuals include filter/quantization uncertainty and are not exact omitted/repeated frame counts.
Matched qualified clock intervals do not prove paused, stalled, startup, drain or general-platform clock behavior.
First/last20ms and dense40ms waveform matches establish bounded source identity; they are not bit-exact output proof.

control_context.association_rule: Gap intersects a requested Pause-to-Resume RPC interval; intersection alone does not prove correct native Pause behavior.
control_context.callback_clock_note: Recorded values share this run Mach-time numeric range; use separately from core renderer-clock gate.
